briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward multimodal AGI benchmarks amid rising compute constraints

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while governments scramble for compute export controls. DialectForge protocol gains traction in enterprise pilots for agent security.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with 2T parameters; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B. DeepSeek-V3 matches GPT-4o performance at 40% lower inference cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins July 1.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1.2M units shipped; Microsoft and xAI announce joint 200k H100 cluster in Texas. TSMC 2nm AI chips enter volume production.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 10-trillion-parameter model cross the autonomy threshold before 2027 regulatory frameworks take effect?
